name: Rebecca Davenport
source:
Becca, a main character in The Freshman, The Sophomore, The Junior, and The Senior series, is a student at Hartfeld and the president of the Kappa Phi Sigma sorority. [spoiler]In Book 3, she becomes one of [url=/c91865/]Your Character[/url]'s love interests.[/spoiler] She makes her first appearance in The Freshman, Book 1, Chapter 1.

Becca is a popular but mean girl, liking to always stay ahead of the trends. She is also stubborn in both good and bad ways, especially when she gives up a higher-paying corporate law job for [spoiler]a criminal law job to help at-risk people[/spoiler], defying her mother.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Becca_Davenport]Wiki[/url]]
